def search(xs, target):
    lo, hi = 0, len(xs) - 1
    while lo <= hi:
        mid = (lo + hi) // 2
        if xs[mid] == target: return mid
        if xs[mid] < target: lo = mid + 1
        else: hi = mid - 1
    return -1

    async with aiohttp.ClientSession() as session:

        return await asyncio.gather(*tasks)
